---
name: bmad-forge-idea
description: Turn an early product idea into a concise, testable concept for this RAG application. Use when asked to shape a rough idea before requirements.
---

# Forge an idea

Clarify who has the problem, what they need to do, and why the current RAG
workflow falls short. Produce a concise concept, key assumptions, a testable
hypothesis, and a low-cost validation step. Keep ideation distinct from a PRD or
technical design; use `bmad-prd` or `bmad-spec` when asked to formalize it.
